ModMetaData.name: Test Harness — Trial Execution (issue #72)
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: The mod that is ADDED to the active list between run A and run B, exercising the trial-execution escape hatch (issue #72). It is simultaneously BOTH of SubDocExpander's blunt decline conditions at once: it is wholly new this load (absent from run A's baseline DependencyGraph.json), AND its own patch is a PatchOperationSequence (a container op) applied by the changed mod itself. Both conditions are individually sufficient to force needsFullRebuild. The sequence's two operations target only this mod's own two new ThingDefs -- both already inside the dirty set via the added-defs channel (P2) before the sequence ever runs -- so a bounded trial replay (TrialExecution.TryRun, scoped to dirty union context only) can prove the sequence safe without seeing any of the rest of the def universe. The runner (TestMods/run_test.sh --expect-trial-execution) symlinks it always but only inserts its packageId into ModsConfig.xml before run B, so run B is a genuine mod-list change. No game content -- dev/QA use only.
